snippet.title: Loftia - Closed Beta Teaser | Gridfall
snippet.description:
Wishlist Loftia on Steam today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2320980/Loftia/
Loftia is launching into Closed Beta on April 22nd, at 2pm PDT! 🥳

After 3 years of development, we're so excited to be finally showcasing everything we've been working on. Loftia's Beta will be a closed playtest for our Kickstarter Backers and Loftia Partners, and there'll be multiple Beta key giveaways from now until our Beta launch date. Join our Discord to stay updated on how you can participate: discord.com/invite/loftia

Full detailed on Beta can also be found on our official Beta website: https://loftia.gg/beta/

Thank you for being a part of this journey together with us, and we can't wait to see you in Loftia soon! 💛

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/loftia.gg/reels/?hl=en..
TikTok: tiktok.com/@loftia.gg?lang=en
